items.question: How many products are in the catalog?
items.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_products,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE launched_on <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (discontinued_on IS NULL OR discontinued_on >= DATE '2026-10-01')
  ) AS active_products
FROM products;

items.question: Which countries do we sell to in Asia Pacific?
items.sql:
SELECT c.code AS country_code,
       c.name AS country_name,
       c.currency_code AS currency_code
FROM countries c
JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id
WHERE r.code = 'APAC'
ORDER BY c.name;

items.question: How many support tickets are still open or pending?
items.sql:

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS open_tickets,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending') AS pending_tickets,

items.question: What was total net revenue in 2025?
items.sql:

FROM order_revenue
WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01';

items.question: What is the average net order value in 2026 so far?
items.sql:

  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd,

items.question: How many customers do we have in each region?
items.sql:

  region_code,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_order_at IS NOT NULL) AS customers_with_orders
FROM customer_profile
GROUP BY region_code
ORDER BY customers DESC, region_code;

items.question: What was net revenue by product category in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT
  parent_category_name AS parent_category,
  category_name AS category,
  SUM(units) AS units_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(refund_usd), 2) AS refund_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_line_revenue
WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY parent_category_name, category_name
ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC;

items.question: How many delivery support tickets did each EU country have in calendar Q3 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(o.country_code::text, 'unknown') AS country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS delivery_tickets
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN regions r ON r.id = st.region_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = st.order_id
WHERE r.code = 'EU'
  AND st.category = 'delivery'
  AND st.created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND st.created_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY COALESCE(o.country_code::text, 'unknown')
ORDER BY delivery_tickets DESC, country_code;

items.question: What net revenue was attributed to each campaign for orders in 2026, by campaign name?
items.sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS campaign_id,
  c.name AS campaign_name,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(r.net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue r
JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = r.campaign_id
WHERE r.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND r.ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC;

items.question: What was the average resolution time in hours of support tickets by region in 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT r.code AS region_code,
       r.name AS region_name,
       COUNT(*) AS resolved_tickets,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.resolved_at - t.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM support_tickets t
JOIN regions r ON r.id = t.region_id
WHERE t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2027-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY r.code, r.name
ORDER BY avg_resolution_hours DESC;

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql:
SELECT
  region_code,
  region_name,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 2) AS net_revenue_q2_2026,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 2) AS net_revenue_q3_2026,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 2) AS difference,
  ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0)
      - COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0))
      / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM order_revenue
WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY region_code, region_name
ORDER BY net_revenue_q3_2026 DESC NULLS LAST;

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT region_code,
       region_name,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01') AS q2_2026_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01') AS q3_2026_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01')
         - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01') AS difference,
       ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01')
         - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'))::numeric
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01'), 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM order_revenue
WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY region_code, region_name
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: What was the refund rate in each region in 2025 compared with 2026 so far?
items.sql:
WITH by_period AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    region_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN refund_usd ELSE 0 END) AS refunds_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN gross_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS gross_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN refund_usd ELSE 0 END) AS refunds_2026,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN gross_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS gross_2026
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY region_code, region_name
), rates AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    region_name,
    refunds_2025 / NULLIF(gross_2025, 0) AS rr_2025,
    refunds_2026 / NULLIF(gross_2026, 0) AS rr_2026
  FROM by_period
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  region_name,
  ROUND(rr_2025, 4) AS refund_rate_2025,
  ROUND(rr_2026, 4) AS refund_rate_2026_ytd,
  ROUND(rr_2026 - rr_2025, 4) AS difference,
  ROUND((rr_2026 - rr_2025) / NULLIF(rr_2025, 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM rates
ORDER BY refund_rate_2026_ytd DESC NULLS LAST;

items.question: Which customers placed the most orders in 2025? Show the top 5, including anyone tied with the fifth.
items.sql:
WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count,
         ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_revenue o
  WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_count, net_revenue_usd,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank
  FROM cust_orders
)
SELECT r.order_rank,
       r.customer_id,
       cp.customer_name,
       cp.region_code,
       cp.segment,
       r.order_count,
       r.net_revenue_usd
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN customer_profile cp ON cp.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.order_rank <= 5
ORDER BY r.order_count DESC, r.customer_id;

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?
items.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_order_at
  FROM customer_profile
  WHERE first_order_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND first_order_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-02-01 00:00:00+00'
),
repeaters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN order_revenue o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.ordered_at > c.first_order_at
    AND o.ordered_at <= c.first_order_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS cohort_customers,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeaters) AS repeat_customers_90d,
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeaters)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 0), 4) AS repeat_rate_90d;

items.question: What share of customers who signed up in 2024 placed at least one order in 2026?

  SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
  FROM order_revenue o
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT cp.customer_id
  FROM customer_profile cp
  WHERE cp.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND cp.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups_2024,
       COUNT(b.customer_id) AS ordered_in_2026,
       ROUND(COUNT(b.customer_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS share_ordered_2026
FROM cohort c

items.question: Among products with at least 100 units sold in 2025, which one had the highest refund rate?

  product_name,
  SUM(units) AS units_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 2) AS gross_revenue_usd,

items.question: At which local hour of the day did APAC customers place the most orders in 2025?
items.sql:
WITH apac_orders AS (
  SELECT o.id,
         (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE r.timezone) AS local_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN regions r ON r.id = o.region_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE r.code = 'APAC'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND c.is_test_account = false
), by_hour AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_ts)::int AS local_hour,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM apac_orders
  WHERE local_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND local_ts <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT local_hour,
       order_count,
       ROUND(order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_orders
FROM by_hour
ORDER BY order_count DESC, local_hour ASC
LIMIT 1;

items.question: Count every combination of an order item with every other order item
items.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items)::numeric AS n_all,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_line_revenue)::numeric AS n_valid
)
SELECT
  n_all AS all_order_items,
  n_all * (n_all - 1) AS all_ordered_pairs,
  n_all * (n_all - 1) / 2 AS all_unordered_pairs,
  n_valid AS valid_order_items,
  n_valid * (n_valid - 1) AS valid_ordered_pairs,
  n_valid * (n_valid - 1) / 2 AS valid_unordered_pairs
FROM counts;
